comment: 50yo female, sub-Saharan African origin (Nigerian diaspora, immigrated age 35), documented history of Schistosoma haematobium infection (positive ova in urine 2008, treated with praziquantel) plus residual chronic urothelial inflammation on prior cystoscopy. Serology remains positive. No current bladder cancer diagnosis. S. haematobium IARC Group 1 carcinogen — established etiological driver of bladder squamous cell carcinoma (SCC), dominant histology in endemic-region exposure. Praziquantel cures active infection but does NOT reverse chronic urothelial inflammation / squamous metaplasia. Engine fires RF-SCHISTOSOMA-HAEMATOBIUM-BLADDER-PREVENTION (any_of: schistosoma_haematobium_history:positive OR schistosoma_haematobium_ova_urine:positive OR schistosoma_haematobium_serology:positive) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = lifetime urinary surveillance (urinalysis q6-12mo, cytology + cystoscopy for any new hematuria); alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation only. Validates v0.3 §20 less-common infectious pilot. Anchored DIS-UROTHELIAL (SCC histology emphasized in rationale).
